title: LA DeepBlack 095 Solo – Celestial Sun Moon
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing, deepest ebony skin with cool blue-black undertones, late 30s, top-heavy bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — overwhelmingly colossal bust, broad soft shoulders, full belly, wide hips, thick thighs, long locs with gold star cuffs — full body celestial sun and moon body art from neck to ankle, EVERY inch covered, NO bare skin below neck. Bold black outlines — BLAZING GOLD sun face on the belly, SILVER crescent moon on the bust, DEEP BLUE and GOLD stars and orbit lines both legs to ankle, filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: facing camera, both hands gently framing her face, elbows low, chest and belly fully visible.
Footwear: gold navy knee-high platform stiletto boots 8 inch. Nails: extra long stiletto nails, gold sun and silver moon.
Extreme high-gloss oil. MANDATORY pure pitch black background only, NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. CRITICAL: legs show FULL BODY ART coverage hip to ankle to toe. Celestial sun moon art must BLAZE against the deepest ebony skin. Emphasis on the extreme body volume. 8K portrait 2:3 vertical.
